correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the defining tangent vectors and opposite-ray map exactly for K_a, reduces |f_out|^2 to a rational function Phi_a(y), and gives a complete sign analysis of Phi_a'. The threshold polynomial has one positive root in (0,1); above it, the relevant critical point is the unique zero of the derivative numerator in (0,1). The family maximum follows from an exact factored derivative on the low branch and a sign-controlled envelope derivative on the high branch. The standalone checker directly evaluates the geometric definition and agrees with the formulas at representative parameters on both sides of the threshold.

value.rationale: Translated Euclidean disks are the simplest smooth non-norm gauges: the boundary remains exactly round, isolating asymmetry caused solely by displacement of the gauge origin. The exact profile therefore calibrates the newly introduced metric invariant on a canonical family, reveals a nontrivial extremizer bifurcation, and gives a sharp family maximum substantially below the universal bound 2.
